_comment: AUDIT §10-C RUNG S2 (20 Aug 2026) — THE TYPE GATE. TIER 0 of LAW T: free, deterministic, and better than any model at one job — telling you a symbol does not exist BEFORE the organ runs. The class it exists for is the readJsonl() ReferenceError: a name that was never defined, sitting on a path nothing exercised until 03:00. `checkJs` is DELIBERATELY false here and the file's own `// @ts-check` pragma is what opts an organ in — so THE CHECKED LIST LIVES IN THE SOURCE, not in a list in this file that would drift (S3's jugad rule, honoured early). The list may only GROW: scripts/gates.mjs freezes the count and npm test refuses a shrink. `strict` stays off on purpose — this rung buys the undefined-symbol class, not a TypeScript rewrite (the rung's own FORBIDDEN line). @types/node is pinned to 22.x to MATCH THE RUNTIME (Node 22.14), never to `latest`: types ahead of the runtime would bless APIs this machine does not have, and Node 24 lands at S8 step 0 with its types in the same version commit (§10-G).
